notes:
Bullmer / IECHO file: every notch is cut at its own place (the owner's choice) [skip ci]

ar: ملف Bullmer / IECHO (‎.iso): كل حزّ يُقطع في مكانه بالضبط وعمودياً كما رُسم (كان يُزاح حتى 2 مم ويميل، كما يكتبه GRAFIS)

The owner: «الحزّ في مكانه بالضبط في ملف .iso أيضاً». The Bullmer file copies GRAFIS' own: a vertex closer than 2 mm to
the last kept one is dropped, and a notch whose point fell on a dropped vertex was cut from the last kept vertex — its
base up to 2 mm beside its place, the cut slanted. Now a point that carries a notch is never dropped; the contour
itself is cut exactly as before (which of its points are kept is decided without the points put in for the notches).
The PLT was exact already: the two cutting files of a marker agree now.
On the owner's design of today (13 pieces, 5 notches) the largest shift was 0.20 mm; on curves with a point every
2–4 mm the review measured up to 1.94 mm.
The file exactly as GRAFIS writes it stays available: preset «bullmer_as_grafis» (the reference test uses it).
tests/test_notch_exact_iso.py (7): fails on 2.0.22 (two of four notches started 1.1 and 1.9 mm beside their place).
